title: Electric powertrain and electric-mode reactions
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly mention the vehicle being electric or operating in electric mode, with positive comments praising the EV experience and a few negative comments focused on wanting to avoid electrification or on an electric fan failure, while many fragments are too brief or contextual to determine sentiment.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on resistance to the electric component in one plug-in hybrid comment and an electric fan failure in ICE context, with limited examples linking negativity to different subjects within the cluster.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews often mention the vehicle being electric or a first EV experience without enough context to tell whether the customer saw that positively or negatively.
